output.answer: As of November 10, 2026, Salesforce offers Agentforce Coworker as a standalone SKU for $50 per user per month, available now. In September, it introduced Core ($195/user/month) and Advanced ($395/user/month) editions; Max remains $550/user/month, while legacy-edition customer pricing remains unchanged. For Agentforce Help Agent, Salesforce added outcome-based pricing at $2 per resolution, charged only when the agent autonomously resolves an issue from start to finish; pricing became available in July 2026. These are additional, product-specific options—not a single pricing change across all of Agentforce: Salesforce still lists Flex Credits, per-conversation pricing, and per-user licensing.
caveats: Salesforce says pricing is subject to change; the pricing page advises contacting a sales representative for detailed pricing.
Salesforce announced that new Agentforce Industry Editions pricing would take effect later in fall 2026, but the reviewed announcement did not give the specific prices or an exact effective date.
missing_fields: Exact new prices and effective date for Agentforce Industry Editions.

key_facts.fact: Salesforce announced a standalone Agentforce Coworker SKU at $50 per user per month and listed the per-user SKU as available now.
Salesforce announced Core at $195 and Advanced at $395 per user/month, while Max remained $550; existing customer pricing on legacy editions remained unchanged.

Salesforce announced pay-per-resolution pricing for Help Agent, available in July 2026 and charged when it autonomously resolves an issue from start to finish; the current Service add-on page lists $2 per resolution.
Salesforce's pricing page lists consumption pricing through Flex Credits or Conversations, as well as per-user licensing.
